description: Findings the ported gate produces over the batch already deposited with ChEBI, used as a regression anchor. The inputs are not in git (bcp/.gitignore excludes chebi_run_*/), so the test that reads this file skips when they are absent and asserts against it when they are present.

deliberate_divergences.why: The record count is a fact about the run, not a finding about a record. It is reported in the run summary and the manifest instead.
Shared parent skeletons are attributed to every record in the group rather than once per group, so holding or reporting a single record carries the information with it.

SYN-04 matched the solvate word instead of the bare substring 'hydrate', which removed two false positives from the batch: Haloperidol hydrochloride carries the synonym 'Haloperidol chlorohydrate' and (S)-(-)-Propranolol hydrochloride carries 'l-Propranolol Chlorhydrate'. Both are older names for the hydrochloride, not hydrates, and both were reported as a hydrate synonym on an anhydrous entry. The two genuine hits still fire: 'BNTX maleate salt hydrate' and '2-chloro-N6-Cyclopentyladenosine (hydrate)'. CON-03 was fixed the same way earlier; this is the second half of one bug.
